Account: SURG-2026-4410
Statement date: 2026-10-18
Total Disputed Amount: $1943.00

Dear Billing Team,

Please review the selected charges below and provide supporting documentation or a corrected itemized statement. My statement lists gross charges of $2360.00. statutoryCitations: Request an itemized billing review: Please review the identified charges and provide documentation or a corrected statement. https://www.cms.gov/medical-bill-rights

Credit-account billing errors: eligibility matters: Specific billing-error rights may apply to qualifying open-end credit accounts and timely notices. An ordinary hospital invoice is not automatically a qualifying credit account. https://www.consumerfinance.gov/rules-policy/regulations/1026/13/

Nonprofit hospital financial assistance: If applicable, please provide your financial assistance policy, eligibility criteria and the method used to calculate amounts generally billed. https://www.irs.gov/charities-non-profits/limitation-on-charges-section-501r5

Surprise billing protections: Certain emergency or out-of-network bills may qualify for federal surprise-billing protections, depending on coverage and circumstances. https://www.cms.gov/medical-bill-rights
